shortDescription: Create/delete a project in Packet host

options.name: auth_token
options.description: Packet API token. You can also supply it in environment variable E(PACKET_API_TOKEN).

options.name: custom_data
options.description: Custom data about the project to create.

options.name: id
options.description: UUID of the project which you want to remove.

options.name: org_id
options.description: UUID of the organization to create a project for. When blank, the API assumes the default organization.

options.name: payment_method
options.description: Payment method is name of one of the payment methods available to your user. When blank, the API assumes the default payment method.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target.
